# Loading Libraries & Reading Data

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: fenced

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

my_data <- mtcars
my_real_data <- read_csv("../data/taxonomic_data_2.csv")
#../ goes back one parent directory so you can access the data folder. Remember this RMD quarto document is sitting in the docs folder so we need to do the ../ to get back to our main directory.
head(my_real_data)
```

# Inserting Figures and Figure Captions

```{r}
#| label: fig-mpg
#| fig-cap: "Scatterplot of Car Weight vs. MPG"
#| echo: fenced

ggplot(my_data, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Weight", y = "Miles Per Gallon")
```

::: callout-tip
Notice how we can also do this: as shown in @fig-mpg
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| fig-cap: "Average MPG by Cylinder Count"
#| echo: fenced

my_data %>% 
  group_by(cyl) %>% 
  summarise(avg_mpg = mean(mpg)) %>% 
  kable()
  
```
